notes.5.257: Line 257: vineis is read as vincis (“you conquer”).

nodes.text: for him you conquer whatever you subdue. The fates leave nothing
in between here: for if you refuse to be his assassin,
you will be his slave. Surely, if by a straight path the Chaldean
observes the stars, if the Colchian knows herbs,
if the Etruscan [knows] lightning, if the Thessalian draws forth shades,
if the lots of Lycia are wise, if by their flight
the birds speak our fates, if with learned bleatings Hammon
groans something holy beneath the Syrtis, if, lastly, you sing the truth,
Phoebus, Themis, Dodona, after our times
